**Build passes now.** Two real bugs from the bump, both in the link stage.

| File | Bug | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | `options.retries` renamed to `retryCount` | read either key |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | unset flag is `undefined`, not `false` | treat unset as `false` |

The other 8 warnings are real deprecations, not noise. `crypto.createCipher` in `src/legacy/adapter.js` is the one worth fixing next.
